contradictions.summary: pipeline.phases emits AUTO/PARTIAL/MISSING/STALE/GAP/NOT_YET from field presence and freshness. Issue #147 requires PASS/PARTIAL/MISSING/STALE/BLOCKED/NOT_YET/NOT_APPLICABLE plus inputs, hashes, equations, and artifacts. AUTO is not PASS and not proof of execution.
PHASE_SCRIPT.md step 9 and run_gate.check_simv6 require tools/sim_v6.py. That path is absent. Scratch engines live at calibration/simv56/engines/cc_sim_v6.py and are not the contract entrypoint.
Phase 14 and pipeline.sim100k run one NFL-43 possession simulation of 100000 trials. They do not run Monte Carlo, calibrated Bias, and Game Randomness at 100000 each.

core/period_engine_v0/monte_carlo.py says Bias is UNIMPLEMENTED. cc_sim_v6.py describes fitted multipliers but loads none, because __no_calib__.json and tools/sim_v6_calib.json are absent. Neither may be called calibrated.
docs/PHASE_WORKFLOWS.md says the official_inactives hook has no owner yet. pipeline/hooks.py REGISTRY binds phase15.official_inactives:hook.
docs/DATA_FRESHNESS.md says the four-book default includes Bovada. pipeline/hooks.py REQUIRED_BOOKS default is fanduel, draftkings, betmgm, williamhill_us.
